children: Indonesia’s annual inflation accelerated to 3.19% in August 2026 from July’s three-month low of 2.28%, slightly exceeding market expectations of 3.13%.
Despite the pickup, inflation remained within Bank Indonesia’s 1.5%–3.5% target range.
Core inflation, which excludes volatile food and government-administered prices, rose to 2.92% in August, the highest since March 2023.
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.21%, reversing a 0.14% decline in July and broadly in line with forecasts of a 0.2% increase.

title: Indonesia Inflation Picks Up to 3.19%
